name: awq_evolve
description: Evolve AWQ and Tessera sparse-residual policies via the GA driver. Reads .npz layer bundles, runs the genetic search (with islands + transfer ledger), and writes a llama.speculative.calibration-policy.v1 JSON consumable by llama-quantize --tessera-policy.

checkpoint.description: Path to a checkpoint file to resume the GA from.

base_policy.description: Acceptance policy to preserve and refine.

islands.description: Number of islands for the island model.

max_tokens.description: Cap on calibration tokens per bundle.

transfer_ledger.description: Progressive observer ledger used to prioritize late-surviving tensors.

sensitive_generations.description: Base generations for each sensitive tensor (0 uses family generations / 4).

sensitive_population.description: Base population for each sensitive tensor (0 uses family population / 2).

saved_compute_reinvestment.description: Multiplier applied to the observer budget saved by progressive freezing.

progressive_eval.description: Successively promote candidates from stratified evidence to full scoring.

screen_fraction.description: Fraction of candidates promoted past the screen.

refine_fraction.description: Fraction of candidates promoted past the refine stage.

promotion_margin.description: Margin required to promote a candidate.

progressive_diversity_slots.description: Diversity slots in the progressive promotion queue.

candidate_batch_size.description: Maximum candidate matrices per MLX activation-projection wave.

model_role.description: Component role for this AWQ evolution pass (trunk, dflash, dspark, mtp_nextn, shared_embd). Stamped on every per-family and per-override entry in the output policy.
